title: SQL Injection through string concatenation in QueryBuilder::where()
root_cause: A request-supplied value is concatenated into the WHERE clause of a QueryBuilder query instead of being bound via createNamedParameter(). The value becomes part of the SQL string, so an attacker controls the query structure.

origin.note: The published advisory names the vulnerability class and the affected extension, not the concrete code location. This fixture reproduces the class in an idiomatic TYPO3 repository; it is not a reconstruction of the vendor's actual code.
